review.notes: No findings file REV-PKG-HabiroCohomologyFoundations~adv.md exists in the repository, so the binding adversarial pass of PACKAGE_REVIEW.md was rerun on the whole package against QH v2, QW v5, KU v1, TC v4, GSWZ v2, Pridham v4, Sch v1 and the Stacks tags. Every defect found is fixed. (1) Supplier obligation from FIX-PKG-RefinedTraceMethods~adv item 1: new §4.28 exports, functorially on pairs and with no trace input, the β-periodic q-Hodge object (qHodge.periodic, QH 3.8 and the proof of Lemma 3.9), the filtration completion and q-Hodge-completed qdR (QH Remark 3.6, Proposition 3.47(a)), and the full Habiro descent datum (twisted filtrations, partial descents, limit, q-Witt filtration, monoidality, finite-projective base change; HabiroHodgeDescent). It records that RefinedTraceMethods and Layer 6 consume this interface. New §5.26 owns finite-coefficient pairs on ℤ/m for every powerful m, which contains the source's high-powered m, via the explicit lifts of TC Lemma 3.16 (all p, α≥2). It also records that TC v4 Lemma 3.7 (p.32) wrongly treats the uncompleted global qdR of ℤ/m as rationally trivial: non-Hodge-completed dR of the zero ℚ-algebra is ℚ, so the pair is glued with the constant rational filtration; the completed filtration and qHdg that the consumers use are unchanged. Pridham Theorems 1.17/1.23 are cited in §4.8 (qHodge.framed_lambda) and GSWZ Definition 1.1 in §4.28 and §5.25. (2) GENERALITY: §5.13 algebraic Habiro cohomology is restated over any perfectly covered Λ-base, with ℤ as the principal case, since Theorems 3.11 and 4.11 and the étale q-Witt sheaf hold there. (3) Corrections: §1.3 notation clash between completed polynomial and divided-power brackets; §6.1 wrong KU locator (§4.3 pp.41–44 replaced by 3.1–3.2 p.24, 4.18 p.46, 4.18a p.49, Theorem 4.27 p.50) and the p=2 addendum (R2) stated exactly; §4.18 proof route made precise (localisation at q^d−1 and the first ghost map, QH Lemma 3.46); §5.19 TC sentence corrected; §5.1 and §3.2 now flag the source slips in QH Lemma 4.2(a) (τ*_n is a right adjoint of the inclusion) and QW Lemma 3.7 (d∘F_n=n(F_n∘d)); §1.12 and several locators tightened; the TauCeti.QHodge names are declared planned names. (4) Suggested.lean follows the 2026-10-19 rules. Removed: five examples and the theorem derived_quotient_torsion_witness, which concerned only library objects (zero map on ZMod 2, DividedPowerAlgebra, cyclotomic 3, zpow of units); their computations remain README Checks. Added: the real-bodied torusScaleHom via AddMonoidAlgebra.lift, its action milestone, two sign-pinning examples, and cyclotomic_prime_decomposition ([p]_q=p·u+(q−1)^{p−1}, u(1)=1); empty layer headers were dropped. lean-check: exit 0, exactly seven sorry warnings (jackson_calculus, uniformDenominator_pos, torusScaleHom_action, torusScale_exists_unique, coefficientRelation_eval, qHodge_polynomial, cyclotomic_prime_decomposition), no other warnings or errors; 216 lines, five real-bodied definitions, ten proved examples. check_sorry_data exit 0; mech_check: 0 README identifiers missing from Lean, 0 empty sections, 0 round labels; intake check-files 0 problems. No target or hypothesis was weakened or renamed. The pass table and source-issue records are in research/blueprint/handoff/FIX-PKG-HabiroCohomologyFoundations~adv.md.
